is_anopheles.evidence: The paper focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae, An. arabiensis, An. coluzzii, An. melas) and An. funestus.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports on Vgsc L1014F (kdr) and Ace-1 G119S mutations.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper is a retrospective review/meta-analysis of previously published data. It presents aggregated trends (e.g., frequency percentages in figures) but does not provide the raw genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or sample sizes for the individual populations analyzed in this specific paper.

african_field_population.evidence: The study analyzes field-collected mosquitoes from Benin.

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is a retrospective analysis/review of data collected from 37 previously conducted studies (as stated in the Results section, page 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided at the municipality/department level (e.g., Cotonou, Allada, Dassa, Parakou, Kandi, Malanville).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study analyzes data collected over specific time windows (e.g., 2010-2024).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper explicitly states it is a retrospective analysis of data from 37 previously published studies and the CREC database.

supplement.evidence: The paper is a review and does not contain primary raw data.

assessment.summary: This paper is a retrospective review of insecticide resistance data in Benin from 1996 to 2024. It synthesizes findings from 21 selected documents to describe the evolution of phenotypic resistance and resistance markers (kdr L1014F and ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations. As a secondary analysis/review, it does not provide primary raw genotype counts.
